findings.evidence: mathlib Basic/Sign/Basic.lean:98 `variable [Ring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]` guards signHom; grep of Polynomial.lean shows only `.eval`/`sign`, no field operation on R.
findings.fix: Replace with `variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]` (a linear ordered comm ring). Also fix the docstring line 18 ("hold over any ordered field") to match the weaker hypothesis.
findings.issue: `[Field R]` is stronger than used. No division/inverse on R appears anywhere; sign requires only `signHom : α →*₀ SignType` (`[Ring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]`), `evalRingHom` needs only `[CommSemiring R]`, and the rational inverse `fullInverse` lives entirely over ℚ, independent of R.

findings.evidence: count_moments signature `{K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]`; solve_counts proof body `simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hA, Matrix.one_mulVec]` uses only semiring matrix algebra.
findings.fix: Generalize to `{K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]` (or `CommRing K`) for `weight`, `A`, `proposed`, matching `count_moments`. Note `support_exact` genuinely needs an ordered K for `Nat.cast_pos`, so state it over `[LinearOrderedField K]` (or a `StrictOrderedSemiring`) rather than concrete ℚ.
findings.issue: `solve_counts` fixes `weight : I → S → ℚ`, `A`, `proposed` to ℚ, but its proof is pure `mulVec_mulVec`/`one_mulVec` cancellation with no rational-specific content, while the identity it consumes (`count_moments`) is already stated over general `[CommSemiring K]`. This is an under-generalization at the wrong level.

summary: The material is at roughly the right ternary level, but two assumptions are stronger than needed: R is required to be a Field though no division is ever used, and the core solver lemma solve_counts is pinned to ℚ though its proof is pure matrix cancellation over any commutative semiring.
